hypothesis: Initial cross-month pair feature predicts held-out public priors beyond span, but might only capture shared origin/destination margins. Residualize both source and target geometry against span plus origin/destination effects, retain shuffled-pair control.
geometry: Same fixed span spline plus full origin/destination one-hot, ridge1, unpenalized intercept.
source: Other two public months only, each normalized by its positive median; mean source minus ridge1 geometry fit to source values. No target held-out values in features.
negative_control: Fixed permutation of source residual within ten normalized-span bins.
evaluation: All three public months, five fixed shuffled OD-entry folds; outcomes are supplied weak-prior entries, never true OD. Follow-up on already exposed data, not independent whole-system validation.
scope: Even repeatable pair signal could be common synthetic noise; no actual OD candidate, official baseline unchanged, no Kaggle upload.
